sentences.en: A few years ago, I was [employed|^1|1] by the McDonald's [Corporation|^2|2].
sentences.ch: 幾年前，我受僱於麥當勞集團。

sentences.en: On "Ronald Day," I would dress up as [Ronald McDonald|\*|#1] and visit the community hospital's sick children.
sentences.ch: 在「麥當勞叔叔日」那天，我會打扮成麥當勞叔叔去探訪社區醫院裡的病童。

sentences.en: Most of these young patients were [suffering|^3|3] from [terminal|^4|4] [illnesses|^5|5].
sentences.ch: 這些年幼的病患大多數都受到末期疾病的折磨。

sentences.en: Thus, I would try my best to ease their pain.
sentences.ch: 因此，我盡可能緩解他們的病痛。

sentences.en: And I found it [tremendously|^6|6] rewarding to be able to bring some [laughter|^7|7] to the kids.
sentences.ch: 而且我發現能夠將一些歡笑帶給這些孩子是相當有意義的。

sentences.en: One of the rules of my job was never to visit the children alone when I was dressed as Ronald, for I might [frighten|^8|8] them with my painted face and red [wig|\*|#2].
sentences.ch: 我的工作規定之一就是在我打扮成麥當勞叔叔時絕對不能單獨去探望孩童，因為我彩繪的臉和紅色的假髮可能會嚇到他們。

sentences.en: I wasn't permitted to have any physical [contact|^9|9] with the children either, since doing so might [pass on||p1] [germs|^10|10] [to them||p1].
sentences.ch: 我也不被允許跟那些孩童有任何肢體接觸，因為這樣做可能會將細菌傳給他們。

sentences.en: Though I understood the [reasoning|\*|#3] behind these rules, I also felt that sometimes nothing could convey love, [empathy|\*|#4], and [warmth|^11|11] like a [heartfelt|\*|#5] embrace.
sentences.ch: 雖然我了解這些規定背後的道理，但我也覺得有些時候沒有東西能夠像一個由衷的擁抱那樣去傳達愛、同理心和溫暖。

sentences.en: Once, as I was leaving the hospital after finishing my work for the day, I heard a voice coming from a half-open door.
sentences.ch: 有一次，當結束我那天的工作後，正要離開醫院時，我聽到一個聲音從一扇半開的門傳來。

sentences.en: "Ronald," the [frail|^12|12] voice called, [prompting|^13|13] me to push open the door and go in.
sentences.ch: 那個虛弱的聲音叫道：「麥當勞叔叔」，促使我推開那扇門走進去。

sentences.en: I found a small boy of about five lying in bed and looking extremely weak and pale.
sentences.ch: 我發現一個大約五歲的瘦小男孩躺在床上，而且看起來極度虛弱和蒼白。

sentences.en: "His name is Billy," his parents told me, smiling.
sentences.ch: 「他的名字叫Billy」，他的父母告訴我，並微笑著。

sentences.en: It was really heartbreaking to see such a young boy [confined|^14|14] to a hospital bed.
sentences.ch: 看到這樣年幼的男孩被困在醫院的病床上，真的很讓人心痛。

sentences.en: I knew I had to do anything I could to [cheer||p2] little Billy [up||p2], so I stayed and did some magic tricks for him.
sentences.ch: 我知道我必須要盡我所能地鼓舞小Billy，所以我留下來為他變了一些魔術。

sentences.en: A [sparkle|^15|15] soon came to his eyes and I asked if I could do anything else for him.
sentences.ch: 他的眼睛很快有了神采，然後我問是否可以為他做任何其他的事。

sentences.en: Billy replied, "Ronald, can I have a [hug|^16|16]?"
sentences.ch: Billy回覆道：「麥當勞叔叔，可以給我一個擁抱嗎？」

sentences.en: Although having to [turn||p3] him [down||p3] pained me deeply, I had no choice.
sentences.ch: 雖然必須拒絕他讓我非常難過，但是我別無選擇。

sentences.en: I told Billy that it was against the rules and then quickly added that we could do some coloring instead.
sentences.ch: 我告訴Billy那樣做違反規定，並很快補充說我們可以為圖畫著色來替代。

sentences.en: A while later, it appeared that he was getting [drowsy|^17|17], so I rose to my feet to get ready to leave.
sentences.ch: 過了一會兒，他看起來開始昏昏欲睡，所以我站了起來準備離開。

sentences.en: That was when he [tretched|^18|18] out his tiny arms to hug me.
sentences.ch: 就在那時他伸出他的小小手臂要抱我。

sentences.en: I [was about to||p4] [refuse|^19|19] again, but then I saw the look of hope in his eyes.
sentences.ch: 我正要再次拒絕，但是那當下我在他眼中看見盼望的神色。

sentences.en: Suddenly, I realized I no longer cared if I was caught breaking the rules.
sentences.ch: 突然，我了解到我已經不在乎我是否會被抓到違反規定。

sentences.en: Some things in life, [after all||p5], were more important.
sentences.ch: 畢竟，生命中有些事是更重要的。

sentences.en: I picked him up and held him in my arms.
sentences.ch: 我把他抱了起來，將他擁抱在我的懷中。

sentences.en: After that, we talked and talked.
sentences.ch: 在那之後，我們聊了又聊。

sentences.en: He [confided|\*|#6] his worries to me.
sentences.ch: 他向我吐露他的煩惱。

sentences.en: He was afraid that his little brother would have no one to play with.
sentences.ch: 他擔心他的弟弟會沒有人可以一起玩。

sentences.en: Also, he was scared that his dog would go hungry because he had hidden all its bones.
sentences.ch: 此外，他怕他的狗會挨餓，因為他把牠所有的骨頭都藏起來了。

sentences.en: It seemed that Billy knew he would never be going home.
sentences.ch: Billy似乎知道他將永遠不會回家了。

sentences.en: And yet, even then, he was only thinking of others.
sentences.ch: 然而，即使在當下，他仍然只為別人著想。

sentences.en: When I finally stood up to leave, I gave Billy's parents my number and told them not to [hesitate|^20|20] to call me if I could be of any assistance.
sentences.ch: 當我最後起身要離開時，我給了Billy的父母我的電話號碼，告訴他們如果有我可以幫得上忙的地方，不用猶豫就打電話給我。

sentences.en: Two days later, I received a call from Billy's mom, who told me her son had [passed away||p6].
sentences.ch: 兩天之後，我接到了Billy母親打來的電話，告訴我她的兒子已經過世了。

sentences.en: She wanted to thank me for [making a difference||p7] in his life, for he'd said to her, "Mommy, I don't mind if I can't see [Santa|\*|#7] this year because I've hugged Ronald."
sentences.ch: 她想要謝謝我對他的人生有所影響，因為他曾對她說：「媽咪，如果我今年看不到聖誕老人，我不在意，因為我已經抱過麥當勞叔叔了。」

sentences.en: How can twenty sticks of dry spaghetti, a yard of tape, a yard of string, and one marshmallow help build a stronger team?
sentences.ch: 20根乾的義大利麵條、一碼膠帶、一碼細繩，還有一顆棉花糖，這些東西如何能幫助打造一個更強的團隊？

sentences.en: An [innovative||1] popular team-building exercise known as the Marshmallow Challenge [promises||2] to do just that.
sentences.ch: 一個名為「棉花糖挑戰」的創新團隊建立活動可望達到這個目的。

sentences.en: In this challenge, with only the [materials||3] [mentioned||4] above, teams need to build the tallest free-standing [structure||5] [capable||6] of supporting the weight of one marshmallow at the top.
sentences.ch: 在這項挑戰中，各隊只能使用上述的材料，打造出一個最高的獨立結構體，頂端能夠承載一顆棉花糖的重量。

sentences.en: With only 18 minutes to complete the task, the teams must learn to [collaborate||7] quickly.
sentences.ch: 只有18分鐘能完成任務，各隊都必須快速學會團隊合作。

sentences.en: The Marshmallow Challenge, promoted by Canadian technology expert [Tom Wujec|*|#1], has been conducted around the world with [architects||8] and engineers, [CEOs|*|#2], lawyers, business [graduates||9], and even [kindergarteners|*|#3].
sentences.ch: 棉花糖挑戰由加拿大科技專家Tom Wujec所推廣，已有世界各地的建築師、工程師、企業執行長、律師、商管研究生、甚至是幼稚園學生參與活動。

sentences.en: Over the years the challenge has produced some surprising results.
sentences.ch: 這些年來，這項挑戰已產生一些驚人的成果。

sentences.en: In Wujec's study, the average height of the structures [constructed||10] was 20 inches.
sentences.ch: Wujec的研究顯示，各隊打造出的結構體平均高度為20英寸。

sentences.en: The group that built the highest structure was, as expected, architects and engineers.
sentences.ch: 一如預期，打造出最高結構體的為建築師與工程師。

sentences.en: CEOs performed [slightly||11] better than average, coming in third.
sentences.ch: 企業執行長的表現略優於平均，排第三位。

sentences.en: Lawyers, on the other hand, performed below average, [ranking||12] second to last.
sentences.ch: 另一方面，律師表現低於平均，排在倒數第二名。

sentences.en: And despite working to create the best plan, business graduates performed the worst.
sentences.ch: 商管研究生雖然很努力創造最佳方案，表現卻最差。

sentences.en: Amazingly, kindergarteners [outperformed|*|#4] most of the adult teams to achieve the second best performance.
sentences.ch: 令人驚豔的是，幼稚園學生的表現勝過大部分的成人隊伍，位居第二。

sentences.en: The impressive performance of the kindergarten group, whose structures were taller than those of most adult teams, can be explained by several reasons related to their [unique||13] way of thinking.
sentences.ch: 幼稚園學童的表現令人讚歎，他們搭建的結構體比多數成人隊伍的還要高，這可以從他們獨特的做事方式中找到數個原因來解釋。

sentences.en: One reason is that kids usually get started with what has been given to them right away, whereas adults usually don't start putting the structure together until they have spent most of the time planning.
sentences.ch: 其中一個原因，便是孩童通常就手邊現有的東西便立刻開始做，而成人通常直到花了大部分時間規劃才開始組裝結構體。

sentences.en: This leaves no time to [adjust||14] the design if it cannot support the marshmallow.
sentences.ch: 如此一來，一旦成品無法承載棉花糖的重量，他們也沒時間可以調整設計了。

sentences.en: Another reason is that unlike adults, kindergarteners are quicker to change their methods after failed approaches.
sentences.ch: 另一個原因是，與大人不同，孩童一旦失敗，便能很快改變作法。

sentences.en: They [rely||15] on [trial and error||16] —if one method doesn't work, they quickly move on to the next.
sentences.ch: 他們靠反覆試驗、從錯中學—如果一個方法行不通，便快速轉換到下一個。

sentences.en: This approach gives them immediate [feedback||17] about what design [elements||18] work to give their structure height and [stability||19].
sentences.ch: 這種作法讓他們立即獲得反饋，知道什麼樣的設計元素可以讓成品更高更穩。

sentences.en: Still another reason for their success is that children tend to collaborate freely and naturally. They don't waste time deciding who is [in charge||20]. Instead, they are more focused on working together to [figure out||21] how to build the tallest structure.
sentences.ch: 他們的優異表現還有一個原因，便是孩童往往自然而然就能互助合作，不會浪費時間決定誰要帶頭，而是花心思一起想出怎麼樣做出最高的結構體。

sentences.en: The Marshmallow Challenge teaches us that age and experience are not the only [routes||22] to success.
sentences.ch: 棉花糖挑戰教我們年紀與經驗並非通往成功的唯二道路。

sentences.en: In order to solve problems, we must [roll up our sleeves||23] and [get down to||24] work right away, [explore||25] and experiment with new ideas, and collaborate effectively.
sentences.ch: 要解決問題，就要立刻挽袖幹活，探索與嘗試新思維，並有效合作。

sentences.en: In this way, we can surely keep the marshmallow at the top.
sentences.ch: 如此一來，必能將棉花糖穩穩地置於頂端。
